name: @amzn/asr_lambdas
description: Non-Orchestrator Lambda functions in ASR, including the Pre-processor and backend API lambdas.

scripts.check: bash -c 'set -o pipefail; ../../deployment/dynamodb-local.sh bash -c "npm run format && npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && npm run test:sequential" 2>&1 | node ../../deployment/utils/filter-test-output.js'
scripts.build:tool-schema: npm run build:ts && node mcp-server/writeToolSchema.js && npm run build:clean:ts
scripts.test:sequential: npm run test:sequential:preprocessor && npm run test:sequential:common && npm run test:sequential:api && npm run test:sequential:synchronization && npm run test:sequential:notification && npm run test:sequential:mcp-server
scripts.test:sequential:preprocessor: npm run build:clean:ts && export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'Pre-processor Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=pre-processor/coverage --silent
scripts.test:sequential:common: npm run build:clean:ts && export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'Common Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=common/coverage --silent
scripts.test:sequential:api: npm run build:clean:ts && export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'API Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=api/coverage --silent
scripts.test:sequential:synchronization: npm run build:clean:ts && export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'Synchronization Unit Tests' 'IaC Template Sync Unit Tests' 'Baseline Configuration Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=synchronization/coverage --silent
scripts.test:sequential:notification: npm run build:clean:ts && npm run test:sequential:notification:channels && npm run test:sequential:notification:dispatcher && npm run test:sequential:notification:batch
scripts.test:sequential:mcp-server: npm run build:clean:ts && export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'MCP Server Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=mcp-server/coverage --silent
scripts.test:sequential:notification:channels: export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'Notification Channels Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=notification-channels/coverage --silent
scripts.test:sequential:notification:dispatcher: export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'Notification Dispatcher Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=notification-dispatcher/coverage --silent
scripts.test:sequential:notification:batch: export POWERTOOLS_DEV=true && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/.bin/jest --selectProjects 'Batch Processor Unit Tests' --runInBand --coverage --coverageDirectory=batch-processor/coverage --silent

overridesJustification.@aws-sdk/util-dynamodb: Pin the compatible transitive version used by release 3.1.8. Later util-dynamodb 3.996.x releases require @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb ^3.1111.0, which conflicts with the requested 3.1094.0 SDK alignment. Remove after client-dynamodb and lib-dynamodb are upgraded to at least 3.1111.0.
